**Finding submitted: deviation (§ 19.2, p0076).**

- **What passes:** § 19.1 (professional/workmanlike + conformance to documentation), § 19.3 (no malicious code, compliance with Applicable Law, no functionality reduction, open-source protection), § 19.4 (re-perform/repair/replace, then terminate-and-refund; not exclusive for fraud, IP, confidentiality, privacy, security, indemnity), and § 19.5 (disclaimer expressly does not limit express warranties) — so the disclaimer does not swallow the warranty.
- **What fails:** § 19.2 caps the Deliverable conformance warranty at **fifteen days**, below the fallback floor (90 days software / 30 days services), and its cut-off ("after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation") would extinguish the open-ended § 19.1 warranty and the § 19.4 remedy. With a fifteen-**business**-day acceptance window in § 6.1, there is effectively no post-acceptance coverage.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** 15 days → **ninety (90) days**, delete the cut-off, and add a non-limitation cross-reference preserving §§ 19.1/19.3 and the §§ 6.2/19.4 remedies.
